title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 13127 Broadway Street in Alden, New York, as the "Sergeant Brett E. Gornewicz Memorial Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 13127 Broadway Street in Alden, New York, as the "Sergeant Brett E. Gornewicz Memorial Post Office."

summary.headline: This law names a post office in Alden, New York, after Sergeant Brett E. Gornewicz.
summary.what_it_does: The law gives an official name to the U.S. Postal Service facility at 13127 Broadway Street in Alden, New York. The facility will be called the "Sergeant Brett E. Gornewicz Memorial Post Office." The summary does not describe any other changes to how the post office operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on August 8, 2014.
